title: Cry
text:
Lord, rend my flesh-
Carve Thy will upon my chest.
Trim and clean and purify,
Neatly snip and prod and pry.

Lord, I am weak-
Life's much harder than it seems.
I'm begging for Thy support,
Please, O God, hold up my fort.

Lord, I see Thee-
In my soul I feel thy peace.
Oftentimes I felt I'd die;
With Thy strength I made it by.

title: Darkest of All
text:
Darkest of
⭐️All the
⭐️Time's slowed
⭐️Down came
⭐️Christ lights
⭐️Up we
⭐️Look to
    Jesus
note: Read the first word of every line for a hidden message

title: Gifts of the Spirit
text:
A man told me once
That I had been blessed with a few gifts.
At the time I had considered his speech
As a "throwaway line" and didn't really give it much thought.
In my newfound knowledge I realize that I was quite the dunce.
As I study now the wisdom I missed,
My younger self (if I couldst) I wouldst beseech:
"Please young man, consider the gifts that you've got."

title: Dear Aubrey across the Sea
text:
Dear Aubrey across the Sea
I bet you didn't expect a "poem letter" from me
I Usually find it tough to write
But if it's a poem, I just might 😂
I'm doing well, the service is great
But being a missionary is a heavy weight
At the end of each day I am tired and wasted
But you wouldn't believe all the joy that I've tasted
As I mentioned, I feel quite tired
But through humble prayer, I'm always inspired-
To move forward and teach stronger;
The Lord makes sure I can go a little longer.
I've taught many lessons and learned many things
Of the peace from the Gospel, the joy that it brings.
When speaking this language I've stuttered and stammered
But not yet I've been 100% hammered.
I'm not quite sure why I can understand well,
But (again) through much prayer, your knowledge can swell.
In Japan (unrelated) I've eaten a lot;
You wouldn't believe all the fish that I've bought 😂
Squid, octopus, eel and urchin
Thankfully none left my stomach hurtin'

title: A Peek into the Mind of Elder Killian
source: A peek into the mind of Elder Killian
text:
The warm winter weather is throwing me off
If a Japanese person said to me "it's cold" I would scoff 😄
Coming from the dry and icy Utah winters
Hearing this weather is "comparable" would leave me in splinters.

The news is out. Elder Mackay has transferred.
He thought he'd be leaving, and that wish was indeed answered 😂
I'm staying here in the Marugame branch
Unrelated, I'm still upset I can't find ranch 😢 (to eat with pizza of course)

As suggested by the title above
This email will be full of rhythm and love ;)
I'm a poet by nature; I rhyme what I think.
My wish is, today, that this poetry won't stink 😅

At least not to the extent of the stench on the porch
That lurks and lingers before the great scorch.
The scorch of course meaning the landfill's bright fire. 🔥
If I said there weren't 3 full trash bags sitting on our balcony... well, I'd be a liar 😁

I hope that these stanzas will give you a hunch
As to the condition of our apartment after lunch...
A bowl in the sink, a plate on a chair-
Which fortunately I convinced Elder Mackay to take care (of).

Yet alas, now he's gone. And I don't mean to be mean...
But with the new Elder Martinson this apartment will probably be much much more clean 😂
One funny detail from my time with Elder Mackay
Was the time in the schedule he'd create for his... lacky 😓

It's not quite as bad as it sounds, I assure
But the "tidy time" in our schedule sure passed by in a blur 😂
As I spent the hour washing the windows with care,
I'd glance over to see him asleep in his chair 😂

But what can I say, I'm a charitable guy ;)
If I'm the only one in the kitchen, [as long as there aren't onions] I won't cry
Though... as a bit of revenge to add to the heap,
I admit that I'd let him stay there asleep 😴 😂

All in all this last transfer has been quite the blast!
My time with Elder Mackay went by way too fast 🏃♂️
I've done lots of work! But occasionally shiver...
When I think of accidentally ordering a large serving of... liver 🐖

title: Haiku Collection
text:
"Life is Meaningless,"
Satan wouldst have you believe.
Ponder not those words.

"Love one another"
Commanded our Redeemer.
"Turn yourself outwards"

Clouds are mighty thin
You'd be surprised at just how
Close we are to God

It's late, I will sleep.
I love all of you so much!
Elder Killian

title: Mission Poetry
text:
I was told to write a poem about Febreeze
I got laundry to do, but my knees...
Are weak from the biking I've done all day...
Guess I've got nothing left to say...

I love you guys, each and every one.
Living in Japan is a lot of fun.
Not much longer and I'll be done.

I don't know how I should feel about that...

title: Zombie Art Poem
text:
A rainbow zombie head on a piece of paper.
It's staring back at me
as though it was made of coal.
My sanity is wearing thin as a wafer
and I feel a weariness in my soul.

However, as I speak of the gospel
and I learn of the Savior,
I find joy in my life.
And through these trials I tend to find flavor
and I can make it through all of this drive.

title: Rap Lyrics 🔥
text:
Stanzas trickle from ma-mouth you hear it?
Stance: Wide- flickin in n out you fear it?
Low bars doesn't mean my bar is set low-
Hurdle high dare to fly don't try to run bro

title: Ice Cream in the Freezer
text:
Ice cream in the freezer
I don't wanna fail
don't wanna be a loser
Buying lots of cheese
Not booze

Firewalking isn't very good
On your toes
Or your nose
If you trip and fall
Which I didn't
But I burned my feet pretty badly

Send down a beam of love
Not the rain...
Please, no... not the rain
Anything but the rain...
